summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in rdflib/plugins/sparql (sparql.py, algebra.py, update.py, processor.py, __init__.py) and added test/test_sparql_prepare.py. translateUpdate now returns an Update container on every path, with the prologue built from the single declaration group before the empty-request early exit. evalUpdate iterates update.algebra. prepareUpdate is exported from the sparql package. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions; all verification was by reading the code. Possibly unnecessary extra: a prepareQuery sanity test in the new module.
